title: Baptism of the Holy Spirit
definition: The baptism of the Holy Spirit is the Spirit's work of uniting believers to Christ and placing them into the body of Christ.
summary: By the Spirit, believers are joined to Christ and to one another. This work establishes their identity as part of God's redeemed people.
christFocus: Christ is the baptizer with the Spirit, forming His people into one body under His lordship.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: By the Spirit, believers are joined to Christ and to one another. This work establishes their identity as part of God's redeemed people.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, follow Christ faithfully, and avoid confusion in doctrine and daily life.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
